## Surface contract

- tools/list, prompts/list, resources/list, resources/read, and resources/templates/list return ttlMs and public or private cacheScope.
- Tool ordering is deterministic and stable enough for prompt caches.
- listChanged and subscriptions/listen invalidation align with TTL hints and never allow stale authorization decisions.
- inputSchema and outputSchema accept applicable JSON Schema 2020-12 keywords and resolve references under bounded depth, bytes, and composition work.
- structuredContent accepts any JSON value while tool result envelopes remain predictable.
- Resource-not-found returns Invalid Params and recovery identifies the missing URI without leaking unrelated resources.
- Contract generation, SDK types, MCP tool definitions, docs, golden files, and packed artifacts derive from one source.
MCP server surface and cache contracts: deterministic tools, prompts, resources, JSON Schema 2020-12, ttlMs, cacheScope, and change coherence
Bring every pm MCP list/read/call surface onto the 2026-07-28 schema and caching contract with deterministic ordering, broad JSON Schema support, safe references, and coherent invalidation.

Every cacheable result includes validated ttlMs and cacheScope with documented freshness and privacy semantics; Tool listing is deterministic and cache invalidation composes correctly with listChanged and subscriptions/listen; JSON Schema 2020-12 references and composition keywords work within explicit recursion, size, and work bounds; structuredContent accepts every JSON value and schema-validation refusals are actionable and token-bounded; Resource-not-found uses Invalid Params and never leaks resource existence outside caller authority; SDK, MCP, docs, generated schemas, golden snapshots, and packed artifacts prove one shared contract
Make tool, prompt, resource, template, and read results conformant, bounded, cache-safe, and generated from shared SDK contracts
Clients spend fewer tokens and requests while preserving exact freshness, privacy, and schema semantics
The new revision requires ttlMs and cacheScope on cacheable results, deterministic tool ordering, broader JSON Schema 2020-12 behavior, and different resource-not-found errors
